response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web software engineer with strong breadth across web, mobile, and some systems programming (DLang, C/C++), but the resume shows no experience in SoC/IP modeling, computer architecture, AI accelerator design, GPU workload analysis, or hardware-software co-design — the core requirements of this principal-level performance architecture role. While years of experience satisfy the BS+8 path numerically, the domain mismatch is fundamental rather than marginal.
strengths: 15+ years of professional software engineering experience across diverse stacks
Some low-latency/high-performance systems work (DLang, async I/O, fibers at Sociomantic)
Strong open-source contributions, teaching, and knowledge-sharing track record
concerns: No SoC, IP modeling, or hardware architecture experience of any kind
No AI/deep-learning workload, GPU, or SIMD/MIMD architecture background
Career trajectory is web/product engineering, not performance architecture or silicon

key_factors.factor: No AI accelerator or GPU workload experience
General seniority and systems programming exposure
